_what: Caliper measurements for the pre-component single-duct thrust rig. Replace each null with your value (mm unless stated), then run: python src/cad/generate_test_rig.py
_status: Measured 2026-11-04 on the A2217 test motor (square 11 mm hole pattern = 15.6 mm diagonal); scale platform still unmeasured
_prop_diameter_how: Tri-blade has no opposite tips: measure shaft-hole centre to EACH blade tip, take the largest, multiply by 2. Measured 2026-11-03: 65.1 mm per blade (shaft centre to tip) -> 130.2 mm
_motor_bolt_spacing_how: Centre-to-centre of two ADJACENT M3 holes under the motor (16 or 19 for most 28xx). Leave null to print slotted holes covering 16-19
_motor_base_to_prop_seat_how: Flat underside of the motor to the face the prop hub rests on (prop adapter / bell top)
_motor_center_clearance_how: Diameter needed under the motor for the shaft end / circlip; increase if the shaft sticks out further
_inlet_clearance_how: Scale surface to duct inlet. Keep >= 1 prop diameter so the inlet is not starved; lower only if the stand will not fit your printer
flight_controller_board: APM 2.x (USB shows as Arduino Mega 2560, VID 2341 PID 0010, COM7) - max firmware ArduCopter 3.2.1
